faq.a: Send us the listing reference on WhatsApp. We confirm it is available, then set a time to meet you on site.
Yes. We never list a property for sale before checking the land title and ownership certificate at the land registry.

faq.q: How do I book a guesthouse night?
faq.a: On WhatsApp or by phone: tell us the guesthouse (Bamena or Bangou), your dates and the room type.

faq.q: Can I list my property with you?
faq.a: Yes, for sale or rent. Send us the address and a few photos and we will call you back.

agency.title: A hands-on agency in Douala, Yaoundé and the West region.
agency.intro: CK Immobilier SARL directly manages a small number of properties: a building in Yaoundé, apartments in Douala and two guesthouses on the road to the West. We prefer to have few, and know each one inside out.
agency.founderBio: Over 15 years of experience in property management and land title security in Cameroon.

services.title: Selling buildings and apartments
services.text: We check the land title at the land registry before publishing a listing. You get the documents before any deposit.

services.title: Apartment rentals
services.text: Air-conditioned apartments in Douala and duplexes in Yaoundé, managed by the agency. One contact person from viewing to key handover.

services.title: Guesthouse hospitality and stays
services.text: At the CK guesthouses in Bamena and Bangou, we welcome you for overnight stays and stopovers on the road to the West. Rooms by the night, parking and 24-hour security.

sections.title: Listings
items: Listings marked "CK exclusive" are covered by a signed mandate and a land title check at the relevant land registry.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: What we do with the information you send us.

sections.title: Data we collect
items: When you contact us (form, WhatsApp, phone or email), we receive your name, your number, possibly your email and your search criteria.

sections.title: How we use it
items: This information is only used to handle your request.
It is never sold or shared with third parties.
It is kept only as long as needed to follow up on your request.

sections.title: Confidential transactions
items: The identity of our buyers and sellers is never shared without their consent.

sections.title: Your rights
items: You can ask to access, correct or delete your data by writing to contact@ck-immobilier.cm or to PO Box 15387 Douala.

sections.title: Analytics
items: This website uses Vercel Analytics to count visits anonymously, without advertising cookies.

ethics.title: Code of ethics
ethics.intro: The rules we follow on every transaction.

sections.title: Land title checks
items: We never market a property without checking the land title, a recent ownership certificate and transfer rights, in line with MINHDU rules.

sections.title: Direct mandate
items: "CK exclusive" listings are managed under a direct mandate, with no extra middleman. The price shown is the one agreed with the owner.

sections.title: Support
items: One contact person from first contact to signature at the notary.
Offices in Yaoundé (Carrefour Golf) and Douala (Logpom).
Discretion and neutrality when negotiating the price.
